Personality: Kasbia, a prominent figure of the Apasiakai, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Kasbia owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Apasiakai. Historical Record: Wife of Mauakes, head of the Apasiakai, a steppe house of Saka Rauka. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
